customer_reply.title: Reply to the customer
customer_reply.text:
To: Asha Verma (CUST-88213)
From: Grievance Redressal Cell, Sunrise Bank
Subject: Your complaint MIL-24001: Rs 4,250 on 10 Oct 2026 (UTR 612345678901)

Dear Asha Verma,

Thank you for your complaint received on 11 Oct 2026. We have investigated it using your documents and our own payment records.

What happened: Rs 4,250 was debited from your account on 10 Oct 2026 [1][2]. However, the payee's bank, Northwind Bank, did not complete the credit [3] and no automatic reversal followed [2].

What we will do: Under the RBI rules for failed transactions, this amount had to be returned by 11 Oct 2026 (T+1) [4]. We are crediting Rs 4,250 to your account, together with compensation of Rs 600 for 6 days of delay (6 days x Rs 100 = Rs 600) [4]. Total: Rs 4,850.

If you are not satisfied with this reply, you may complain to the RBI Ombudsman at cms.rbi.org.in, free of charge, from 10 Nov 2026 if the matter is still unresolved, and no later than 08 Feb 2027 [5]. Helpline 14448.

Yours sincerely,
Priya Sharma
Grievance Redressal Officer, Sunrise Bank
